bottleneck.description: World #1 passenger-car lidar by 2024 volume and growing robotics lidar leader (1,458% YoY Q1 2026 robotics growth) in a Chinese-dominated duopoly with Hesai.

dependency.key_customers: BYD, Geely, FAW, NIO, XPeng, Tier-1 robotics OEMs and humanoid integrators, 3,400+ robotics customers
dependency.key_suppliers: Lumentum/Sony laser components, optical assemblies, MEMS mirror vendors, Chinese photonic IC fabs

editorial.notes: RoboSense is the #1 global passenger-car lidar by 2024 volume share and has rapidly expanded into robotics lidar (185,500 robotics units in Q1 2026, surpassing automotive). Combined with Hesai it forms an effective duopoly in Chinese-supplied automotive/robotics lidar, with 310+ automotive brand/Tier-1 design wins (BYD, Geely, FAW). Real but bounded switching friction — Hesai, Huawei and Seyond are credible alternatives; Western customers face geopolitical export constraints similar to TSEM. MEDIUM rather than HIGH given the duopoly structure and active competition.
